newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH FORESTRIES HIT HIGHS ON UPGRADES, US RALLY.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH FORESTRIES HIT HIGHS ON UPGRADES, US RALLY.

text.p: Shares in Finnish forest industry companies UPM-Kymmene Enso and Metsa-Serla rose sharply in early trade on Tuesday on a recent upgrades and a sharp rise in U.S. paper stocks overnight, brokers said.

UPM-Kymmene led the spurt, adding 3.70 markka or 2.7 percent to 141.80 and touched a 142.00 life-high in lively 27 million markka dealings by 1135/0835 GMT. Enso was up 1.50 markka or three percent at a new 51.50 record and Metsa-Serla rose 0.30 markka or 0.6 percent to 49.70.
The forest industry sector index was up 2.6 percent.

Brokers said there were several recent forestry upgrades, and pointed especially to Goldman Sachs'outperform stance reported on Monday, which was based on comparison with Swedish peers. Swedish Assi Doman's first half earnings in the upper range of forecasts supported Finnish forestries, brokers said.
UPM-Kymmene is due to report first half earnings on Thursday at 0800/0500 GMT and Enso early on Wednesday.
"If results support UPM, it will go up to 145.00-150.00 by the year-end," one broker said.
Metsa-Serla last week reported first half earnings near the highest forecast in a Reuters poll.
